title: R3.0E Checkpoint Evidence Manifest — schema
note: Format for governance/r3.0e/checkpoints/<CHECKPOINT_ID>.json. E0 establishes the schema and writes its own manifest as 'pending'; final PASS is expressed by the trusted-verification artifact bound to artifactBoundSha. The checkpoint manifest never self-asserts PASS — only the CI artifact does. Cross-phase advancement of any non-bootstrap E checkpoint additionally requires R3.0D state.currentCheckpoint === 'D5_ENGINEER_BRIEF_ACTIVATION' per scripts/check-r3-0-train.js.

fieldNotes.baseSha: Commit SHA the checkpoint built from.
fieldNotes.headSha: Commit SHA at the head of the checkpoint commit.
fieldNotes.previousCheckpoint: Checkpoint ID that authorized the prior state, or null for E0.
fieldNotes.authorizedPaths: Exact repo-relative production paths newly authorized by this checkpoint. MUST NOT include the frozen R3.0B case-record paths.
fieldNotes.forbiddenCapabilities: Capabilities the checkpoint must NOT enable (cross-checked against state.json).
fieldNotes.tests: Per-file test result digest from the trusted-verification test-manifest.
fieldNotes.workflowRunId: GitHub Actions run id of the trusted-verification gate.
fieldNotes.artifactId: Uploaded artifact id of the evidence bundle.
fieldNotes.artifactBoundSha: SHA the artifact's summary.json was bound to (must equal headSha).
fieldNotes.codexVerdict: Final Codex verdict object (verdict, rounds, findings, fixes).
fieldNotes.frozenDiff: Count of frozen-boundary diff entries (must be 0).
fieldNotes.productionDiff: Count of production lines added under renderer/js touching R3.0E surface beyond authorizedPaths.
fieldNotes.runtimeConsumerCount: Count of production modules that require contracts/r3.0e at runtime.
fieldNotes.featureRegistryState: Snapshot describing whether E5 feature IDs are still absent (E0..E4) or registered (E5).
fieldNotes.packageVersion: Value of package.json version at headSha. Must remain '1.4.0' until R3.0F F6 release.
fieldNotes.createdAt: ISO timestamp of manifest creation. Pass via CI clock or git commit timestamp; do not rely on local Date.now().
fieldNotes.status: 'pending' before CI; 'candidate' once CI started for the head SHA; final PASS lives in the artifact, not here.
fieldNotes.governanceChanged: true iff this checkpoint modifies any file under governance/r3.0e/, governance/r3.0/, scripts/check-r3-phase-*.js, scripts/check-r3-0-train.js, scripts/collect-evidence.js, or .github/workflows/ci.yml.
fieldNotes.crossPhaseGate: Snapshot of the cross-phase gate at this checkpoint: { r3dCheckpoint, requiredFor: <this checkpoint id>, satisfied: <bool> }. The train validator enforces satisfied=true for any non-bootstrap E checkpoint.
fieldNotes.r3bCaseRecordSchemaUntouched: true iff this checkpoint did not modify any frozen R3.0B persistence module (case-record-schema.js, storage-backend.js, schema-migration.js, case-store.js, session-store.js, case-library-viewmodel.js). Enforced by the train validator scope-pin.

statusAuthority: Only the trusted-verification artifact may report status PASS. A checkpoint manifest may carry status: 'PASS' only as a post-merge mirror of an artifact already bound to its headSha.
